crosswalks.label: Software Developers
crosswalks.rationale: Broad software occupation includes application development but not a dedicated desktop-runtime boundary.

findings.summary: Desktop application work is a bounded specialization of broad software development where OS/runtime, packaging and local-state transitions become first-class evidence.
findings.rationale: Research-first compilation makes the specialization boundary explicit before use.

gaps_against_body.description: Make one-platform success, packaging success and actual cross-platform/update continuity separate evidence surfaces.

nonclaims: No complete Desktop Application Engineer reconstruction is claimed.
Occupational mappings are evidence, not profession identity.
No TEST/WORKING/CANON or adjacent authority is created.

high_stakes.authorization_nonclaim: No adjacent professional, platform, security, product or institutional authority is created.
